data.narrative:
Flock Safety, a Series G defense and security company, is valued at $7.5B post-money following $1.4B+ in total capital raised. Valuation assessment draws on a peer set of nine same-sector comparable companies at similar valuation tiers, including five named private peers (Shield AI at $12.7B Series G, Helsing at $18.0B Series D, Saronic at $9.2B Series D, Quantum-Systems at $8.0B Series C, and Chaos Industries at $4.5B Series D), plus two public comps.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applies a typical 1.25x multiplier to the $7.5B last post-money valuation, implying $9.4B. Peer-median analysis across the nine-company comp universe yields a median valuation of $4.5B, with a range spanning $2.1B to $18.0B. This wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity in stage and trajectory across the defense-tech landscape.

Synthesizing both methods produces a triangulated range of $3.8B (low) to $10.8B (high), with a median of $6.9B. The current $7.5B valuation sits within this range, slightly above the two-method median. Key uncertainties center on the appropriate peer weighting given stage dispersion in the comp set and the applicability of historical stage-step multiples in frontier defense markets. Further resolution would require clarity on revenue scale and growth trajectory relative to named peers.
